    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MWGA - 为了复活1000亿行C#代码</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119153138393-653038534.png" alt="MWGA - 为了复活1000亿行C#代码" class="desc_img">
        MWGA是Make WinForms Great Again的缩写，它是一个工具软件，能快速地将使用了GDI+的WinForm.NET程序快速迁移到Blazor WASM平台上，将程序代码修改量控制在10%以下，从而复活全球1000亿行C#代码。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3><span style="font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;"><strong>南京都昌信息科技有限公司</strong></span></h3>
<h3><span style="font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;"><strong>2026-1-15</strong></span></h3>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119161959622-1527980847.jpg" alt="MWGA" loading="lazy"><hr>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">1. 一句话介绍</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">MWGA是Make WinForms Great Again的缩写，它是一个工具软件，能快速地将使用了GDI+的WinForm.NET程序快速迁移到Blazor WASM平台上，将程序代码修改量控制在10%以下，从而复活全球1000亿行C#代码。</span></p>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">2. 项目背景</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">据估计，全球范围内的WinForms开发者约有300万至500万人，占.NET开发者总数的40%至50%。生产环境中运行着1000万至1500万个WinForms应用程序。在这些应用中，60%至80%有现代化改造需求，其中40%至60%优先选择Web化迁移，涉及的C#代码可能有数千亿行。核心驱动因素包括网页端访问、界面现代化、跨平台支持、云集成和安全合规。由于可复用C#代码且具备基于浏览器的跨平台能力，Blazor WebAssembly成为热门选择。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">但是有大量的WinForms使用了System.Drawing模块调用GDI+进行复杂的自定义绘图和交互，这些部分难以通过简单的控件映射迁移，通常需要重写或大幅修改。为此，市场上对低改动、可复用业务逻辑和绘图代码的现代化迁移解决方案需求强烈。但长期以来一直缺乏有效工具和方法，导致许多企业面临高昂的重写成本和风险，存在巨大供需矛盾。</span></p>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&nbsp;</span></h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">3. 我们的目标</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;">M<span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">WGA就是专门帮助将WinForms应用程序迁移到Blazor WASM平台上，即使这些程序使用GDI+功能，我们也预期将对这些程序源码的修改量不超过10%。这极大的降低WinForms软件现代化的成本和风险。</span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我们的长期目标是复活全球1000亿行经过市场验证的C#代码，使其在现代Web前端平台上继续发挥价值。MWGA帮助开发者将一套C#代码同时编译成.exe和.wasm文件，两者运行效果保持高度一致。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>软件下载地址</strong>：<a href="https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/MWGA" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/MWGA</a></span></p>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">4. 竞品对比</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">将WinForms程序迁移到Blazor WASM上，目前业界还有以下解决方案：</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>代码生成式迁移</strong>：使用工具软件解析WinForms的源代码，自动生成Blazor代码，后续独立维护。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>手动重构</strong>：参考原先的WinForms程序，从零开始手写Blazor组件，完全脱离原先的WinForms程序。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>混合桥接（WebView2）</strong>：在WinForms程序中嵌入一个WebView2的浏览器组件，将软件功能一点点的迁移到BS结构中。</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA和其他相同目标的解决方案的对比如下：</span></p>
<table data-draft-node="block" data-draft-type="table" data-size="normal" data-row-style="normal">
<tbody>
<tr><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">对比维度</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">代码生成式迁移</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">手动重构</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">混合桥接</span></th></tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">迁移效率</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">极致快速（数小时）：导入项目即可渲染，很少的编码适配，迁移效率远超其他方案。</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">较快（数天）</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">极慢（周/月级）</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中等（天/周级）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">技术门槛</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">极低（零Blazor/前端基础要求）：仅需熟悉原有WinForms项目，普通开发即可快速上手，大幅降低迁移学习成本；</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中（需基础Blazor知识，需学习新的Blazor技术栈）</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">高（精通Blazor生态，需全面掌握Blazor+前端技术栈）</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中高（需双栈知识，需同时掌握WinForms与前后端技术栈）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">代码修改量</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">普通项目代码零修改。</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">复杂项目和GDI+项目代码修改量小于10%</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中：生成代码后需5%-20%的适配修改（如控件事件绑定、样式调整）；GDI+功能需大幅改写（30%-60%）；需适配Blazor技术栈规范</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">100%：需全盘重写UI代码，仅可复用少量纯业务逻辑代码；GDI+绘图需完全基于Blazor/JS重构；需彻底切换至Blazor技术栈</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中高：需修改30%-50% WinForms代码适配桥接层，同时编写Blazor前端交互代码；GDI+需额外适配桥接渲染逻辑；需掌握双技术栈适配规则</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">成本优势</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">极致成本优势：很少编码人力成本、无学习成本；无需后续代码维护成本；纯前端部署无服务器运维成本；含GDI+的项目可大幅节省重写成本；</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">中：需承担代码生成后适配人力成本，后续维护成本较低；GDI+适配需额外增加成本；需投入Blazor技术栈培训成本</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">极高：全量重写人力成本高，前期学习成本+后期维护成本叠加；GDI+重构成本占比超50%；</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">高：双栈开发人力成本高，桥接层兼容维护成本持续存在，无跨平台成本优势；GDI+适配进一步推高成本；需投入双技术栈学习与适配成本</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">GDI+ 支持</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">良好支持：通过模拟System.Drawing.Graphics等核心类型实现GDI+绘图迁移，可保留原有绘图逻辑与交互效果；同一套代码在WinForms与Blazor WASM环境下界面、逻辑一致；技术栈无变动，绘图相关开发经验可直接复用</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">有限支持：仅能识别基础GDI+语法，复杂绘图逻辑（如自定义渲染、动态绘图）无法直接生成代码，需大幅改写；需基于Blazor技术栈重构绘图逻辑</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">需完全重构：无原生GDI+支持，需基于Blazor组件/HTML5 Canvas+JS重新实现所有绘图功能，学习与开发成本极高；需彻底抛弃原有GDI+开发技术栈</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">部分支持：可保留WinForms原生GDI+渲染，但需适配WebView2桥接通信逻辑，存在性能损耗，且跨平台受限；需掌握双栈下GDI+适配技术</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">技术栈延续性</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">完全延续：无需改变企业现有WinForms技术栈，开发人员可复用原有WinForms开发经验与技能；项目代码结构、开发规范保持不变，仅改变前端渲染形态</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">部分延续：可复用WinForms业务逻辑经验，需切换至Blazor技术栈，开发规范与代码结构需适配Blazor框架要求</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">完全切换：需彻底抛弃WinForms技术栈，全面转向Blazor+前端技术栈，原有开发经验复用率低</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">双栈并存：需同时维护WinForms与Blazor两套技术栈</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">适配场景</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">快速验证迁移效果；</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">对跨平台需求高、数据安全敏感、迁移周期紧张、成本控制严格的场景（优势适配）；</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">含GDI+绘图功能的WinForms项目迁移；</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">注重技术栈延续性、需复用现有开发团队能力的企业项目</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">需长期维护、逐步演进纯Blazor架构项目；无复杂GDI+功能的项目；企业可接受技术栈部分切换的项目</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">大型项目、复杂逻辑、追求极致性能/长期价值；可接受全量重构成本与技术栈完全切换的GDI+项目；企业有明确Blazor技术栈转型规划的项目</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">必须保留WinForms逻辑、仅Windows平台使用；含复杂GDI+功能但无法承担重构成本的项目；企业可接受双技术栈并存的短期过渡项目</span></td>














</tr>














</tbody>














</table>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">5. 使用案例一：扫雷游戏程序，2%代码修改量</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">扫雷是一个经典的Windows游戏程序，我们从<a href="https://gitee.com/dingxiaowei/MineGame" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/dingxiaowei/MineGame</a>下载了一个基于MS .NET Framework2.0的扫雷程序，这是一个10年前写的Winforms程序，包含约2500行C#代码以及若干图片资源文件，编译成.exe文件后运行如下图所示：</span></p>
<p style="text-align: left"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119150249763-657578861.png" alt="winform-mine" width="746" height="548" loading="lazy"></p>







<span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这个程序大量使用System.Drawing.Graphcis.DrawLine()/DrawImage()/FillRectangle()的接口来绘制游戏界面。</span>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我们创建了一个Blazor WASM 9.0的程序，将扫雷程序源码文件复制过来，并做一些兼容性修改，如下图所示：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#if</span> MWGA
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ValueTask&lt;ShowSelfResult&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShowSelf(...)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ShowSelfResult ShowSelf(...)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
    frmCustomGame cg </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> frmCustomGame();
    cg.tbHeight.Text </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> height.ToString();
    cg.tbWidth.Text </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> width.ToString();
    cg.tbMineCount.Text </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mineCount.ToString();
    cg.Location </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> location;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#if</span> MWGA
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> cg.ShowDialog(parent) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DialogResult.OK)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#else</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (cg.ShowDialog(parent) ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DialogResult.OK)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">#endif</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">由于<span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 18pt">Blazor WASM</span>是采用浏览器非阻断线程模式，为此我们实现了异步ShowDialog( )函数，采用await语句来暂停当前代码执行，这样减少对旧代码的修改量。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">最终我们对旧代码修改了不超过50行（占比2%）就让同一套代码可以无需修改即可编译成.exe和.wasm文件。最后编译成.wasm的扫雷程序在谷歌浏览器中的运行结果如下：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="font-size: 14pt"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119150337766-937573910.png" alt="minesweeper" width="732" height="709" loading="lazy"></span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="font-size: 14pt">程序中的上千行图形绘制代码未做任何修改，如下图所示：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
{
    Rectangle rect </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ClientRectangle;
    Graphics g </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> e.Graphics;

    g.FillRectangle(grayBrush, rect);
    drawFrame(g, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Rectangle(rect.Left, rect.Top, rect.Width - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, rect.Height - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (Image != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> offset;

            offset </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            offset </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        g.DrawImage(Image, rect.Left </span>+ <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> + offset, rect.Top + <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> offset);
    }
}</span></span></pre>
</div>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">6. 使用案例二：计算器，无代码修改</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我们开发了一个Winform.NET的计算器程序，包含460行C#代码，其运行界面如图所示：</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;"><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119150421432-37504898.png" alt="winform-calculator" width="607" height="771" loading="lazy"></span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="font-size: 14pt">这里响应了窗体的大小改变事件，用于设置按钮和文本框的位置和大小，其代码如下：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> CalculatorForm_Resize(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">object</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> sender, EventArgs e)
{
    UpdateControlLayout();
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 动态更新所有控件的位置和大小（完全填充窗体，无空白）
</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">///</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">&lt;/summary&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UpdateControlLayout()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取窗体客户端区域（排除边框）</span>
    Rectangle clientRect = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.ClientRectangle;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 处理显示屏（占顶部整行，高度占客户端区域的1/6，剩余部分给按钮）</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> displayHeight = clientRect.Height / <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 显示屏位置：左、上、右间距为fixedPadding，高度为displayHeight</span>
    txtDisplay.Location = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Point(_fixedPadding, _fixedPadding);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> newSize = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Size(clientRect.Width - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> * _fixedPadding, displayHeight - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span> *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _fixedPadding);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">这份C#代码未做任何修改，借助MWGA，它在Blazor WASM中运行界面如下所示：</span></p>
<h1><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/12406/202601/12406-20260119150447246-2132356915.png" alt="calculator" width="732" height="806" loading="lazy"></h1>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">7. 基本原理</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">M<span style="font-size: 14pt">WGA基本原理是模拟System.Windows.Forms.Control类型和System.Drawing.Graphics类型来实现WinForms代码低修改量的迁移。MWGA建立了以下的功能模块映射：</span></span></p>
<table data-draft-node="block" data-draft-type="table" data-size="normal" data-row-style="normal">
<tbody>
<tr><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">HTML功能模块</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA功能模块</span></th></tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&lt;canvas&gt;</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">System.Drawing.Graphics</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&lt;button&gt;</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">System.Windows.Forms.Button</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>

</tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&lt;input type="text"&gt;或&lt;textarea&gt;</span></td>

</tr>

<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">window.alert()</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">System.Windows.Forms.MessageBox</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">&lt;div&gt;</span></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">element.style.cursor</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(51, 102, 255, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">System.Windows.Forms.Cursor</span></td>














</tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MouseEvent, KeyEvent</span></td>
<td style="text-align: center"><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Win32 Message，包括WM_KEYUP、WM_KEYDOWN、WM_LBUTTONDOWN、WM_LBUTTONUP等等</span></td>














</tr>














</tbody>














</table>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA内部还模拟实现了Win32 Message loop和消息队列，构造出了一个Winforms的底层运行框架，使得用户的基于Winforms的C#代码重新编译后即可运行在Blazor WASM上。</span></p>

<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14pt">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;操作系统 : Windows , Linux, Andriod</span></p>

<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">9. 多语言支持</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA支持多语言开发。MWGA内部所有的字符串都剥离出来形成一个字符串资源JS文件，其内容如图所示：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">window.__DCResourceStrings =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    AboutBoxDesc: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">显示该组件的</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>关于<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">对话框</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGCollapse: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">折叠</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGEdit: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">编辑</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGExpand: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">展开</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGNavigate: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">定位</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGNavigateBack: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">向后定位</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGNewRow: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(新建)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGParentRow: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">父行</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccDGParentRows: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">父行</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionCheck: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">选中</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionClick: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">单击</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionCollapse: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">折叠</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionExpand: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">展开</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionPress: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">按</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    AccessibleActionUncheck: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">取消选中</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
};</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">我们目前提供简体中文版和英文版，用户可以修改这个JS文件来使用自己的语言。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">另外MWGA支持ComponentResourceManager类型，如图所示：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InitializeComponent()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> resources = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> System.ComponentModel.ComponentResourceManager(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(dlgMessage));
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.panel1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.Panel();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.pictureBox1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.PictureBox();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.label1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.Label();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.txtMessage = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.TextBox();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.btnOK = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.Button();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.btnCancel = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Windows.Forms.Button();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.panel1.SuspendLayout();
    ((System.ComponentModel.ISupportInitialize)(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.pictureBox1)).BeginInit();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.SuspendLayout();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ...</span>
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">用户可以将程序资源设置到Form.resx文件中，编译后即可使用窗体资源文件。未来MWGA将增强对于.resources.dll的多语言的支持。</span></p>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">10. 开发和部署</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA只包含一个3.8MB大小的DCSoft.MWGA.dl文件，就已经包含了所有的功能，不依赖任何其他第三方组件。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">开发者可参考<a href="https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/MWGA" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/MWGA</a>提供的演示程序来进行基于MWGA的开发。主要步骤是：</span></p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第一，创建Blazor WASM项目</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">创建一个Blazor WASM 9.0/10.0的程序，添加对DCSoft.MWGA.dl的程序集引用。<strong>目前不支持Blazor WASM 7.0/8.0</strong>。</span></p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第二，复制源代码</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">将要迁移的WinForms程序的源代码以及资源文件全部复制到项目中。</span></p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第三，添加引导程序</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">添加标准化的MWGA的引导程序代码，添加运行程序界面的HTML文件。</span></p>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第四，兼容性修改</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">对用户程序代码进行必要的兼容性检查和修改，主要修改点有：</span></p>
<table data-draft-node="block" data-draft-type="table" data-size="normal" data-row-style="normal">
<tbody>
<tr><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">标准WinForms功能点</span></th><th><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA修改说明</span></th></tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">Form.ShowDialog()</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">要将用户函数改造成异步模式，然后使用await Form.ShowDialog()</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">支持P/Invoke，可以使用[DllImport]来导入外界API函数。</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">不支持P/Invoke，必须修改用户代码来删除P/Invoke功能。不过如果P/Invoke功能没被触发，程序仍然能正常运行。</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">窗体资源文件.resx</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">由于源代码文件目录结构改变导致生成的.resx文件重命名，需要调整用户代码来设置正确的名称。</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA自己提供的ComponentResourceManager、ResourceManager已经能自动处理这种.resx的重命名。</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">可直接重写Control.OnPaint方法</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">需要在控件构造函数中调用DCSoft.MWGASystem.SetControlOwnerDraw(this);来通知MWGA要针对这个控件启用Graphics子模块。</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">启用Graphics子模块需要消耗点资源，非必要就不要启用。</span></td>














</tr>
<tr>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MessageBox.Show()</span></td>
<td><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">可以继续使用MessageBox.Show()，但是底层调用了window.Alert()来模拟的，用户界面很丑。</span><br><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">如果需要高仿请使用await MessageBoxNew.Show()，需要将用户函数改造成异步模式。</span></td>














</tr>














</tbody>














</table>
<h3><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">第五，编译运行</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">编译运行程序。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA支持谷歌、火狐等主流浏览器。支持Windows、Linux、Android操作系统。<strong>不支持Windows XP、Windows 7等老旧操作系统</strong>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">发布到生产环境时，可以考虑使用<a href="https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/BlazorWASMPackager" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/BlazorWASMPackager</a>将Blazor WASM程序文件集合打包成一个单独的JS文件，方便部署和维护。</span></p>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">11. 安全性说明</span></h1>
<p><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">MWGA并不是开源软件，但我们采取以下措施来保证这个软件是安全的：</span></p>
<ol>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>限制使用范围</strong>：MWGA的唯一的文件DCSoft.MWGA.dl限制为只能用于Blazor WASM开发。对于其他的软件类型，比如WinForms、ASP.NET CORE、命令行等等不会产生任何效果。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>纯前端组件</strong>：MWGA是一个纯前端的软件组件，没有服务器端程序，只能运行在浏览器沙盒中，没有访问数据库、本地文件系统、注册表和硬件的权限。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>无网络操作</strong>：MWGA承诺不会执行任何网络操作，包括http、ftp、Web Socket等等。而且用户监控浏览器的异常网络行为也是很容易的事情。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>打包建议</strong>：我们建议用户使用<a href="https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/BlazorWASMPackager" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/dcsoft-yyf/BlazorWASMPackager</a>将Blazor WASM软件打包成一个单独的JS文件。可以减少下载程序文件的网络操作，甚至使用本地file://协议运行。进一步的减少网络安全风险。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>无本地数据访问</strong>：MWGA承诺不访问任何本地数据，包括访问浏览器cookies、localStorage、IndexDB、navigator对象等等。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>无高权限操作</strong>：MWGA承诺不会执行高权限有风险的操作。比如操作摄像头、位置信息获取等等。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>用户代码安全管控</strong>：对于用户提供的WinForms应用程序发出访问文件或者数据库连接的请求，MWGA都会触发JS事件，让开发者自己写代码响应事件来处理这种高权限的行为。对于相关的安全风险MWGA完全避嫌。未来MWGA会提供高频变化的安全Token机制，强化Winforms用户代码安全行为的管控。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>错误隔离</strong>：当MWGA或用户代码由于BUG导致程序错误和卡死，由于它是纯前端组件，只能影响到当前终端，重启客户端浏览器即可恢复，不会影响服务器，安全风险小。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>信创认证</strong>：MWGA的姐妹软件DCWriter5采用了相同的软件架构。DCWriter5已经拿到统信、麒麟、方德操作系统原厂适配认证。这间接说明MWGA符合国产信创的要求。</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"><strong>安全提醒</strong>：当MWGA出现了本文档说明之外的高权限行为，可以怀疑DCSoft.MWGA.dl不是正版的，或者遭到病毒和木马的侵犯。即使如此，由于浏览器安全沙盒的限制，用户的运行环境仍然是安全的。</span></li>













</ol>
<h1>&nbsp;</h1>
<h1><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">12. 版权说明</span></h1>
